topIssues.label: Cold or soggy food at handoff
topIssues.whatToDo: Implement temperature checkpoints at pickup/delivery handoff; train staff on food-holding protocols and insulated packaging; audit every 3rd order for temp compliance.
topIssues.rationale: Appears in 15+ months consecutively; spans pickup, delivery, and dine-in; directly impacts customer satisfaction and food safety perception.
topIssues.exampleQuote: Gave them a second chance my food was cold like last time . Picked up my food once it had said it was ready to pick up and I was expecting my food to be warm not cold especially fries and burger.

topWins.label: High food quality execution across concepts
topWins.whatToDo: Standardize recipe execution, ingredient sourcing, and cooking temps across all 14 shops and all concepts via detailed SOPs and monthly audits.
topWins.rationale: Appears in every single month (Jan 2024–May 2026) as top positive driver; customers reward consistency and quality above all else.

topWins.label: Fast service and order fulfillment speed
topWins.whatToDo: Monitor and optimize kitchen throughput, kiosk/app UX, and pickup handoff SOP; staff to volume ratios during peak hours.
topWins.rationale: Consistently praised across all 16 months; speed is a core fast-casual expectation and directly impacts repeat visits.

topWins.label: Multi-concept ordering and bundling execution
topWins.whatToDo: Ensure kitchen coordination SOP for bundled orders; train staff on cross-concept menu knowledge; test kiosk/app UX for seamless multi-brand ordering.
topWins.rationale: Appears in 15+ months; multi-concept bundling is Wonder's unique value prop and must work flawlessly to justify premium positioning.

topWins.label: Friendly, attentive, and helpful staff
topWins.whatToDo: Implement staff training program on hospitality, product knowledge, and allergy accommodation; recognize and retain top performers monthly.
topWins.rationale: Appears in every month; staff warmth and competence are differentiators in fast-casual and drive loyalty and word-of-mouth.
